message: Unknown modifier __debunce on data-on, which Datastar ignores, so it listens for the event click. Did you mean __debounce?

Kotlin interpolates $navn here, as the whole Datastar expression. Meant as a server value, only a number or a boolean is safe there; meant as the signal $navn, make the whole literal $$"""...""" (Kotlin 2.2+), or escape as ${'$'}navn.

Kotlin writes $title into the HTML as it is. If it can hold text from outside, build the string with interpolate(...), which escapes it; if it is markup you built, declare it Html or wrap it in Trusted(...). interpolate(...) cannot take this string while $navn stands in data-text.
Unknown Datastar attribute data-onn. Did you mean data-on?
<div> has no id. Without a selector, Datastar matches top-level elements by id and silently ignores the rest.
